subject: HTML commands conflicting with graph creation

messages.author: 4945c52267751fcf
messages.subject: HTML commands conflicting with graph creation
parts:
I tried inputting some HTML code into my shiny app once i was satisfied with my graph. I set up the ui as follows:

ui<-fluidPage(
+   tags$p('this')
+   sliderInput(label="Choose coef", value=2, min=1, max=3), plotOutput("volcano"))

However I to the following error:

Error: unexpected symbol in:
"  tags$p('Hello')
  sliderInput"

The HTML and the slider seem to conflict with each other. I have tried them independently and they both work.

I also tried:

> ui<-fluidPage(
+   div(sliderInput(inputId="num", label="Choose coef", value=2, min=1, max=3)), 
+   div(plotOutput("volcano")),
+   HTML(<h1>"Hello"</h1>)
Error: unexpected '<' in:
"  div(plotOutput("volcano")),
  HTML(<"
>   )

Again both work independent of eachother.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: HTML commands conflicting with graph creation
parts: You're missing a comma after the p tag and before the sliderInput; those are two separate function arguments that you're passing to fluidPage. (The next version of Shiny will have a clearer error message that will tell you to insert a comma at the appropriate place)
